lessons: Do not unzip untrusted capture archives to disk; inspect ZIP metadata and read bounded streams.
Reject duplicate ZIP member names and path traversal before parsing evidence.
Reject ZIP symlinks, oversized members, decompression bombs, malformed JSON and duplicate JSON keys.
A claimed MIME type is not evidence of content validity; parse JSON and require the expected root shape.
Credential screening must include MAPI-Key and Authorization, and must never echo matching secret bytes.
Sanitized capture copies do not prove exact request bytes used on the wire.
An intake PASS is not a signed-attestation, independent-capture, numerical-result or engineering acceptance PASS.
HTTP 200 with an empty message cannot establish completed Civil NX analysis or numerical result extraction.
